# Spread Love & Acceptance (The Objective Ledger)

> Spread Love & Acceptance is a young, independent start-up building The Objective Ledger: a free, growing suite of self-help tools for understanding yourself and sharing life kindly with the people around you. It brings together practical relationship tools, gentle games, calm breathing and sound spaces, and a plain-language library, with new tools and content added all the time. Everything you type stays on your device.

Key facts:
- Website: https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ . Free to use; everything opens with a free email sign-up, and much of it needs nothing at all.
- Who it is for: anyone who wants to understand themselves and get along more kindly and fairly with others: partners, families, co-parents, friends, roommates, coworkers and caregivers, and people exploring on their own.
- Themes: self-help, relationships, love, kindness, appreciation, acceptance, reconciliation and repair, calm, peace, harmony, breathing and quiet moments, connection, fairness and the invisible "mental load", and differences in how people are wired.
- The Five Pillars: see the whole load; fix the setup, not the person; read your state first; tune how you send and receive; notice the quiet incentives.
- Privacy: what people type into the tools stays on their own device.
- It is education and self-reflection, not therapy, diagnosis or treatment.
- Mascots: two pups, Tidbit (black mask) and Sugarfoot (white feet). Chat helper: Professor Puddles.
- Status: a young start-up with a working, growing suite; new tools and content are added continually (see https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/whats-new.html).
- Contact: patrick.christian.andrews@gmail.com

## Start here
- [Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/): Free, kind self-help for understanding yourself and the people you love: tools for fair, calm relationships, kinder conversations and appreciation, gentle games, breathing and calm soundscapes. Everything stays on your device.
- [About](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/about.html): The story behind Spread Love & Acceptance and The Objective Ledger: fifteen years auditing complex systems, a lifetime of wondering how people work, and a free, growing suite of tools for kinder relationships.
- [Contents](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/contents.html): Everything in the program, in three parts: tools for understanding yourself, tools for any two people, and where to start in your kind of relationship.
- [The Five Pillars](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/five-pillars.html): The five simple ideas behind The Objective Ledger: see the whole load, fix the setup not the person, read your state first, tune how you send and receive, and notice the quiet incentives. Kindness and fairness, made practical.
- [Glossary: the words, in plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/glossary.html): Every word this site uses, like static, frequency, battery, talk window and owner, in one plain sentence with an example, plus each tool’s plain name beside its technical name.
- [How It Works](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/how-it-works.html): The program gives you a calm view of yourself from the outside, like an honest auditor with no verdict on your worth. It looks at your situation, your wiring and what you discover.
- [Is This Right for You?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/is-this-for-you.html): The Objective Ledger helps you understand your own stress and reactions, then gives two people a fair way to see what each of you carries. This page helps you decide if it fits.
- [Membership](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/membership.html): Everything on spreadloveandacceptance.com is free with an email sign-up while the program is being built. Paid membership is coming later.
- [Which part of the program to use](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program.html): The program in one place: six gentle weeks, the Workpaper Suite, the package and report, the fill-in worksheets and the indexes, and which one to use when.
- [How It Fits Your Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/relationships.html): How The Objective Ledger helps every kind of relationship: partners, family, co-parents, friends, roommates, coworkers and caregivers. Fair ways to share the load, kinder words and calmer check-ins.
- [Your Self-Discovery Path](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/self-path.html): The self path: understand your own load, rhythms and reactions first, with a few short workpapers and tools you can use on your own, no one else needed.
- [Sent this by someone?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/sent-this.html): Someone sent you Spread Love & Acceptance? Here is what they can and can’t see, what stays yours, and kind ways to say yes, not yet or no. Nothing is entered about you without you.
- [Start Here](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/start-here.html): New here? Start with the one idea behind Spread Love & Acceptance: understand yourself first, then share the load kindly. The best first steps, free tools and a six-week path for calmer, kinder relationships.
- [Start in 10 minutes](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/start-in-10-minutes.html): One short, straight path through the whole idea: check your weather, read the Preface, try one practice card, and log one thing you did today.
- [Ways In](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ways-in.html): The whole site is free while the program is being built. Most of it needs nothing from you, an email address opens everything else, and paid membership is coming later.
- [What’s new](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/whats-new.html): Everything newly added to the site, and everything that’s grown: new pages, new games, new sounds, and parts of the program that go deeper than before.

## Tools for kinder conversations and fair relationships
- [Chat with Professor Puddles](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ask.html): Chat with Professor Puddles: describe what’s going on in a relationship or ask about any tool, and get kind, practical next steps and words you could use. Free, private and on your device.
- [Can the load last? The full CALC-01](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calc01-solvency.html): The full CALC-01 works out every input from your worksheet entries, for 2 to 8 people, shows the math step by step, and suggests what would move the score. It reads the setup, never a person.
- [Carrier Wave Decoder](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/carrier-wave-decoder.html): Decode the moment a conversation starts to squeal, check your state, practice getting back in tune, and look back on the week together. A free companion to Chapter I of The Objective Ledger.
- [Check-ins](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/check-ins.html): A check-in is a short, agreed talk about one hard topic, at a time that works for both of you. The topic can wait for that time, and it goes much better when it gets one.
- [The Conversation Reader](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/conversation-reader.html): Paste a text thread or chat and see where it turned, what each of you may be hearing, and calmer replies built from your own words. A free, private tool for repair and reconciliation.
- [The Full Path Package and Report](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/full-path.html): One fillable PDF with every workpaper for your road, and a detailed report written from your answers: findings, things worth a second look, recommendations and a plan. For you alone or for 2 to 8 people.
- [Know Your Own Wiring](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/know-yourself.html): Why do I react this way? Sort a reaction into your lasting wiring, patterns life taught you, or today's conditions, then explain it kindly to yourself and to the people around you.
- [The Lemonade Stand — Who did what this week](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/lemonade-stand.html): List what it took to keep your place running this week and how many hours each person put in, plus shared bills if you like. See the split as a plain fact, not a verdict. Runs in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [Today's Weather — A 60-second read on your own conditions](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quick-checks.html): Check your inner weather in about a minute: the sky, the pressure, the ground conditions, sleep, people load and what is pressing. You get a forecast, a talk window, what today is good for, what to leave, an optional 7-day log with a simple trend, and a heads-up you can share.
- [The Signal Translator](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/signal-translator.html): Type a text or message and see how it might land, what the other person may hear, and a kinder, clearer way to say it. A free tone checker for partners, family, friends and work.
- [A quick snapshot](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/): A gentle 2-minute look at how a shared load is set up and how it bends, for partners, families, roommates, co-carers and teams. Not a test or a diagnosis.
- [The 2-minute snapshot](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/snapshot-diagnostic-snapshot-interactive.html): Seven quick questions about how a shared load is set up and how it bends under pressure. You get one of four areas, the scoring shown openly, and one small step for this week. Not a test and not a diagnosis.
- [Turning Toward](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/turning-toward.html): Connection is built in small, everyday moments. Seven simple practices for love and appreciation: noticing when someone reaches for you, specific thanks, celebrating good news and gentle repair after a hard moment.
- [Wired Differently](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wired-differently.html): The same words can land very differently, depending on how each person is wired. This guide helps you speak so the message you meant is the message that arrives.
- [Wiring Card](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wiring-card.html): Make a one-page wiring card: how you receive words, what silence means, what to avoid, and how a request should be phrased. Free. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

## Worksheets (the Workpaper Suite)
- [Try the workpapers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/): A practice space to try the core worksheets on a worked example before you use your own week. Nothing is saved.
- [Workpaper Playground](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/workpaper-playground.html): Practice the core worksheets on a worked example: log a week (WP-01), check a battery (WP-02), name owners (WP-03) and see if the load can last (CALC-01). Nothing is saved.
- [Six gentle weeks (PROG-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/prog-01.html): A six-week path through the program, one step at a time. Follow the weeks in order. It works best with the other person, but you can do it on your own.
- [Program Overview](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program-overview.html): How the program fits together: the chapters explain the ideas and the worksheets put them to use. It also says plainly what is built and what isn't yet.
- [Suite Index](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/suite-index.html): The official list of what’s built today. If something is listed here, it’s live and ready to use. If it isn’t listed, it isn’t live yet.
- [Can the load last? (CALC-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/calculators/calc01-solvency.html): The quick CALC-01: type in the totals from your worksheets, for 2 to 8 people, and see whether the way you share the load can last, with every step of the math shown.
- [Your progress, week by week (REPORT-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/report-01.html): One place to type in what your worksheets produced each week, and a report that reads them side by side to show where they agree and where they don’t.
- [Who did what, and kind ways to say no (WP-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-01.html): A one-week log of who did what at home, plus simple scripts for saying “not right now” without starting a fight.
- [How much are you carrying? (WP-02)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-02-battery-stress-meter.html): A quick check on yourself that separates how much you are already carrying from how upset you are about this one thing.
- [One owner per job (WP-03)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-03-raci-treaty.html): A shared list that gives every regular household job one clear owner, so you stop re-deciding who does what every week.
- [What keeps coming back? (WP-04)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04-deficit-audit.html): Once a month, together, you look back at four weeks of logs to find the jobs that keep slipping, and fix the setup instead of patching it again.
- [WP-04 — The Deficit Audit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04.html): WP-04 in full: the monthly look-back over four weeks of Field Audit logs, sorting the jobs that keep slipping.
- [Say it so it lands (WP-09)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-09-tone-filter.html): A quick self-check to run before you answer something that landed hard, so what you say is something the other person can actually hear.
- [WP-11 — The Calm-Down Kit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-11.html): WP-11: an earlier version of the Calm-Down Kit, built around calming your senses.
- [The 90-second daily check-in (WP-13)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-13-pll-protocol.html): A 90-second daily check-in that makes small corrections every day, so little things don’t build up into a big weekend argument.
- [WP-01 — Field Audit & Neutral Refusals](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-01.html): WP-01 in full: the 7-day Field Audit and the expanded guide to kind ways to say no, in one document.
- [WP-02 — The Battery & Stress Meter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-02.html): WP-02 in full: a five-question check on yourself that separates the stress you're already carrying from how upset you are about one thing.
- [WP-03 — The RACI Treaty](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-03.html): WP-03 in full: the RACI Treaty gives every regular household job one Responsible name and one Accountable name.
- [WP-04 — The Deficit Audit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-04.html): WP-04 in full: the monthly look-back over four weeks of Field Audit logs, sorting the jobs that keep slipping.
- [WP-09 — The Tone Filter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-09.html): WP-09 in full: the transducer (for what you send) and the filter (for what you hear), for retuning before you respond.
- [The Sound Toolkit (WP-11 companion)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11-sound-toolkit.html): Three simple background sounds you can try as part of your Calm-Down Kit: a low hum, a soft flutter and brown noise. A matter of taste, not a treatment.
- [WP-11: The Calm-Down Kit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11.html): A plan you make while calm, for bringing your body back down in a heated moment, so you can finish the conversation or honestly put it off.
- [WP-13 — The Phase-Locked Loop](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-13.html): Working Paper WP-13: the 90-second daily check-in and weekly catch-up that keep small drifts from building up.

## Calm, breathing and sound
- [Drift — a calm visualizer with soft tones](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calm-visualizer.html): Drift is a calm visualizer: tell it how you feel, put on headphones and let slow, dreamy visuals and gentle tones keep you company for a few quiet minutes of breathing and rest.
- [Echoes of Gold — The Companion Album](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/echoes-of-gold.html): Echoes of Gold (The Christian Project): the 11-track album that came before The Objective Ledger, produced by Christian, performing as Loves Journey EP.
- [The Night Garden — a calm place to breathe and play](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/night-garden.html): A peaceful garden at night: breathe slowly with the light to make flowers bloom, guide fireflies into constellations and stack glowing stones on the pond. A calm, free place for quiet minutes.
- [Pal Cam TV](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pal-cam-tv.html): Tidbit and Sugarfoot on the big screen, all day. Full screen, the screen stays awake, and the scene changes with the time of day.
- [Soundscape Catalog](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/soundscapes.html): Calm soundscapes and gentle music made for The Objective Ledger: breathing tracks, peaceful ambient pieces and songs about love, acceptance and finding your way back to each other.

## Calm games
- [The Daily Ledger Crossword — a newspaper-style crossword](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/daily-ledger-crossword.html): A newspaper-style crossword: a new 5x5 Mini every day, a bigger grid through the week and a 13x13 Big Sunday on Sundays, the same for everyone. Easy to play on a phone. No timer, no way to lose.
- [Play The Frequency Journey — a calm adventure for Sugarfoot and Tidbit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-journey-play.html): Guide Sugarfoot and Tidbit through seven gentle, tone-themed worlds to find the Perfect Frequency. A different small challenge at every level: riddles, puzzles, breathing, sorting and more, about trust, change, joy, connection, voice and seeing clearly. No timer, no way to lose.
- [The Frequency Journey — Tidbit and Sugarfoot’s search for the Perfect Frequency](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-journey.html): The Frequency Journey: help Tidbit and Sugarfoot find the Perfect Frequency through seven tone-themed worlds of calm puzzles, riddles and small lessons about harmony, patience and being in tune with each other.
- [Pause & Play — calm games for a busy mind](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pause-and-play.html): Calm games for a busy mind: the Night Garden, the Frequency Journey, Word Bloom, two crosswords and Quiet Words. No timers and no way to lose, just a peaceful few minutes with Tidbit and Sugarfoot.
- [The Quest Map](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quest.html): A friendly map of the whole program, grouped by the Five Pillars. Each chapter, workpaper, guide, tool, game and library shelf lights up as you explore it, and each finished learning trail lights a lantern.
- [Quiet Crossword — small, gentle crosswords](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-crossword.html): Small, friendly crosswords with gentle clues. A new themed one every day and thousands more, from gentle to expert, easy to play on a phone. No timer, no way to lose.
- [Quiet Words — a calming word search](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-words.html): A gentle word search with no timer and no way to lose. Each word you find glows, rings softly and leaves a kind thought behind. A new theme in every puzzle.
- [Word Bloom — a calm letter-wheel word game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/word-bloom.html): Swipe across the petals to spell words and fill a little crossword. Thousands of wheels in five sizes, a bonus jar, and now and then something new in the garden behind the page. No timer, no way to lose.

## The book
- [Why we get out of tune (Chapter I)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-1.html): Why two reasonable people can end up in a fight neither of them started, and how to get back in step.
- [Is the split working? (Chapter II)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-2.html): One gentle question: can the way you share the work keep going, or is one of you quietly running on empty?
- [Full tanks and different angles (Chapter III)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-3.html): Why some reactions are bigger than what caused them, and why two people can see the same moment so differently.
- [Two kinds of fair (Chapter IV)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-4.html): Agree on what “fair” means before you argue about it, and give a comment a moment to land before you answer it.
- [The monthly look-back (Chapter V)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-5.html): Once a month, look back for the problems that keep coming back, and fix the setup instead of having the same argument again.
- [The work nobody sees (Preface)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/preface.html): Running a shared life takes a lot of work that nobody sees. This book is about making that work visible to both of you, so you can talk about it fairly.

## The Professor’s Library and further reading
- [The Frequency Framework](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-framework.html): Two people can each run on their own rhythm for money, rest, decisions, talking and values. When those rhythms clash you get friction, and knowing them turns that friction into something you can plan around.
- [Stories from Philosophy](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/learn/): Twelve old stories from philosophy, retold in plain words. They help you know yourself, see the other person more clearly, and keep a ledger without letting it replace the person.
- [The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library.html): The Professor’s Library: 233 plain-language entries on relationships, conflict and reconciliation, kindness, gratitude, emotions, stress, calm and differences in wiring, with honest notes on the evidence.
- [Calm and attention · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/calm.html): Slow breathing, mindfulness, nature, music, breaks, phones, mind-wandering and flow, with modest, honest claims.
- [Talking and listening · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/communication.html): Listening, I-statements, validation, feedback, questions, texting and the other everyday skills of being understood.
- [Conflict and how to resolve it · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/conflict.html): Negotiation, de-escalation, repair, apology, mediation and fair process, from research and practice.
- [Kindness and connection · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/connection.html): Gratitude, good news, self-compassion, loneliness, friendship, kindness and the small rituals that keep people close.
- [Feelings and emotions · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/emotions.html): What emotions are, how people regulate them, naming feelings, shame and guilt, anger, rumination, grief and resilience.
- [Fairness and the load · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/fairness.html): Equity, the second shift, the mental load, invisible work, and why we each think we do more.
- [Family, money and life changes · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/life.html): Family systems, in-laws, co-parenting, new babies, stepfamilies, money, moving, ageing parents, holidays and the big transitions of life.
- [Motivation, habits and change · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/motivation.html): Why people do things, how habits form, procrastination, perfectionism, mindset, self-esteem, values and making change stick.
- [How relationships work · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/relationships.html): What decades of research on couples, families and friends say about what keeps people close.
- [Stress and the body · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/stress.html): The stress response, allostatic load, the window of tolerance, polyvagal theory and its critics, sleep, hunger and burnout.
- [Systems and teams · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/teams.html): Borrowed tools from project management, safety science and teamwork: ownership, blameless reviews, checklists and why shared jobs slip.
- [Thinking traps · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/thinking.html): The biases and mental shortcuts that make us assume the worst, remember selectively and misread each other.
- [Differences in wiring · The Professor’s Library](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/wiring.html): Neurodiversity, the double empathy problem, autism, ADHD, sensitivity, personality and chronotype.
- [Observational Podcast: The Kane and Christian Experience](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/podcast-index.html): The Objective Ledger podcast series: episodes exploring workpapers, chapters, and real-world applications of the framework with Kane and Christian.
- [Further Reading](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/reading.html): Hand-picked articles from Psychology Today, Greater Good Magazine, The Gottman Institute and other trusted sources, sorted by topic and by the Five Pillars, for understanding yourself and getting along with others.
